description: This file contains functions for validating JSON against a schema, fetching and processing trace JSON files from GitHub URLs, and replying to issues with trace data or errors. It is part of a Probot GitHub app component handling trace data validation and communication.

methods.name: validateJsonSchema
methods.description: Validates JSON content against a schema and returns validation result and errors.

methods.name: sendTrace
methods.description: Fetches a JSON trace file from a GitHub URL, validates it, and returns the stringified content if valid.

methods.name: replyWithTrace
methods.description: Replies to a GitHub issue with a trace message, mainly for testing purposes.
